<thought>Analyzing the spectrum shows a clear 1 Da spacing (M‑1, M, M+1) typical of the 13C isotopic pattern, and a pronounced M+2 peak about 20‑30 % of the base peak, characteristic of a single chlorine atom (35Cl/37Cl). These patterns uniquely identify carbon and chlorine. No other element shows a distinctive pattern strong enough to be certain.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
